messages:
Marta: Quick sweep — I'm pulling together a single view of 'soft' cross-team deps that could nudge Q2 milestone sequencing. If you have items that are not formal blockers but could add ~1–3w risk, drop them here with owner and rough impact. I'll synthesize and flag the critical path.

Ken: infra/quantization validation is one. Owner: eng-runtime (Ken). Impact: 2–3w if model regressions show up during perf tests.

Aisha: Console redesign (dashboards + per-model cost view). Owner: product (Aisha) + eng-platform. Impact: ~1w if we rework spec; low chance but blocks some observability items.

Jun: TLS cert rotation on dedicated gateways — infra (Jun). Impact: can cause a 2-day rollout hold if loadbalancers need manual updates. Not likely but worth noting.

Tom: Dedicated autoscale tests depend on quantization validation finishing. If validation slips >1w, autoscale test window compresses and we risk a rollout delay.

Marta: ok adding those. Quick sketch I'm going to paste into the map — please confirm or add missing owners.

Marta: ```
- Q2 week 4: quantization validation (eng-runtime / Ken) -> downstream: dedicated autoscale tests (eng-sre / Tom)
- Q2 week 3: console redesign milestone A (product / Aisha) -> downstream: release gating dashboards (eng-platform)
- Q2 ongoing: cert rotation (infra / Jun) -> downstream: customer VPN handoffs
```

Ken: Confirmed. Also call out model-ranking evals — if we see a quality regression we'll need a 2w rollback window. Owner: eng-ml (Ken).

Aisha: Suggest we de-scope dashboard polish from the initial release and ship a minimal cost view. If we do that, the sequencing impact goes to zero. :thumbsup:

Marta: Good trade. Can you post the minimal spec today? I’ll update the critical path.

Aisha: Will do, pushing a short doc by EOD.

Tom: FYI: eng-sre can shift the autoscale test window by a week if infra provides a staging capacity increase. Jun — can you confirm we can carve +1 GPU for week 5?

Jun: I can carve one node out of the staging pool for week 5 but we need to re-run perf jobs — gives us +1w buffer.

Marta: Perfect. With that buffer, the quantization -> autoscale coupling is less risky. I'll mark quant validation as a near-critical item but not blocking.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: Q2-week5-stage (auto) — please ensure all test jobs complete 24h prior.

Marta: Thanks, everyone. Action items: Ken add fallback criteria for quant tests, Aisha share minimal spec, Jun confirm staging carve + perf run, Tom to adjust autoscale schedule. I'll circulate the consolidated dependency map after EOD.

Ken: On it.

Aisha: Assigned.

Jun: Confirmed.

Tom: Updated schedule this afternoon.
